/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[CardMstAction]    Script Date: 19-04-2023 03:16:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CardMstAction]
(
	@iPk_CardId int = 0,
	@sCardName varchar(1500) = null,
	@dCardBalance decimal(18,2) = null,
	@dtCrtDate varchar(20) = null,
	@IsActive bit = 0,
	@iFk_FinYear int = 0,
	@iFk_Createdby varchar(15) = null,
	@iFk_ApprovedBy varchar(15) = null,
	@Flag varchar(1) = '1'
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF(@Flag = '1')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO MSTVEHCRD 
		(
			sCardName,
			dCardBalance,
			dtCrtDate,
			IsActive,
			iFk_FinYear,
			iFk_Createdby,
			iFk_ApprovedBy
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@sCardName,
			@dCardBalance,
			@dtCrtDate,
			@IsActive,
			@iFk_FinYear,
			@iFk_Createdby,
			@iFk_ApprovedBy
		)
		SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Insert' AS Message
 	END
	IF(@Flag = '2')
	BEGIN
		UPDATE MSTVEHCRD SET sCardName =@sCardName,
			dCardBalance = @dCardBalance,
			dtCrtDate = @dtCrtDate,
			IsActive = @IsActive,
			iFk_FinYear = @iFk_FinYear,
			iFk_Createdby = @iFk_Createdby,
			iFk_ApprovedBy = @iFk_ApprovedBy WHERE iPk_CardId = @iPk_CardId
			SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Update' AS Message
	END
	IF(@Flag = '3')
	BEGIN
		SELECT * FROM MSTVEHCRD WHERE iPk_CardId = @iPk_CardId
	END
	IF(@Flag = '4')
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM MSTVEHCRD WHERE iPk_CardId = @iPk_CardId
		SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Delete' AS Message
	END
	IF(@Flag = '5')
	BEGIN
		SELECT * FROM MSTVEHCRD
	END
	IF(@Flag = '6')
	BEGIN
		UPDATE MSTVEHCRD SET IsActive = @IsActive WHERE iPk_CardId = @iPk_CardId
		SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Update' AS Message
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[CardRechargeAction]    Script Date: 19-04-2023 03:16:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CardRechargeAction]
(
	@iPk_CARDRCHRG int = 0,
	@iFk_CardType int = 0,
	@iFk_VehicleId int = 0,
	@iRechMode int = 0,
	@sCardNumber varchar(1500) = NULL,
	@dAmount decimal(18,2) = NULL,
	@dtRechDate varchar(20) = NULL,
	@iFk_CreatedBy varchar(20) = null,
	@iFk_CheckedBy varchar(20) = null,
	@iFk_ApprovedBy varchar(20) = null,
	@iFk_YearId int = 0,
	@iFk_BranchId int = 0,
	@sIpAddress varchar(500) = null,
	@sLongitude varchar(500) = null,
	@sLatitude varchar(500) = null,
	@sBrowser varchar(500) =null,
	@sDevice varchar(500) = null,
	@iIsDeleted int = 0,
	@Flag varchar(1) = '1'
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF(@Flag = '1')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO CARDRCHRG (
		iFk_CardType,
		iFk_VehicleId,
		iRechMode,
		sCardNumber,
		dAmount,
		dtRechDate,
		iFk_CreatedBy,
		iFk_CheckedBy,
		iFk_ApprovedBy,
		iFk_YearId,
		iFk_BranchId,
		sIpAddress,
		sLongitude,
		sLatitude,
		sBrowser,
		sDevice,
		iIsDeleted
		)
	VALUES(
	@iFk_CardType,
	@iFk_VehicleId,
	@iRechMode,
	@sCardNumber,
	@dAmount,
	@dtRechDate,
	@iFk_CreatedBy,
	@iFk_CheckedBy,
	@iFk_ApprovedBy,
	@iFk_YearId,
	@iFk_BranchId,
	@sIpAddress,
	@sLongitude,
	@sLatitude,
	@sBrowser,
	@sDevice,
	@iIsDeleted
	)
	SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Insert' AS Message
	END
	IF(@Flag = '2')
	BEGIN
		SELECT C.iPk_CARDRCHRG,E.sName AS cardName,V.sUnqIdNo AS vehicleNumber,CASE WHEN C.iRechMode = '1' THEN 'CARD' ELSE 'MOBILE' END AS RechargeMode,
		C.dAmount AS CardAmount,C.dtRechDate AS dtRecharge,C.sCardNumber AS CardNumber  From CARDRCHRG C
		INNER JOIN CSTMENUM E ON C.iFk_CardType = E.iPK_CustEnum
		INNER JOIN MST_Veh V ON V.iPK_ID = C.iFk_VehicleId
	END
	IF(@Flag = '3')
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM CARDRCHRG WHERE iPk_CARDRCHRG = @iPk_CARDRCHRG
		SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully DELETE' AS Message
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[GetddlforCardRC]    Script Date: 19-04-2023 03:16:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetddlforCardRC]
(
	@type varchar(20) = null
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF(@type = 'CardName')
	BEGIN
		SELECT C.iPK_CustEnum AS DDLValue,C.sName AS DDLText from CSTMENUM C 
		INNER JOIN MSTVEHCRD M ON M.sCardName = C.sName WHERE C.iFK_EnumNo = 13
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		SELECT iPK_ID AS DDLValue,sUnqIdNo AS DDLText FROM MST_Veh
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[USP_ADMIN_CustomFields_View]    Script Date: 19-04-2023 03:16:30 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON

SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
-- =============================================
-- Author:		<Abhishek Rohilla>
-- Create date: <22.Sep.2022>
-- Description:	<This SP is used to custom field in customer enum form
-- =============================================
CREATE Procedure [dbo].[USP_ADMIN_CustomFields_View]
AS
Begin
Select C.iPK_CustEnum,C.iFK_EnumNo,C.sName as EnumName,C.iId,IsNull(C.iIsActv,1) Active from CSTMENUM C 
order by C.sName
End

/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[DocMstAction]    Script Date: 21-04-2023 02:49:31 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DocMstAction]
(
	@iPk_VehDcmntId int = 0,
	@iFk_DcmntId int = 0,
	@IsExpired int = 0,
	@iNoOfDays int = 0,
	@dtCrtDate varchar(20) = null,
	@IsActive bit = 0,
	@iFk_FinYear int = 0,
	@iFk_Createdby varchar(20) = null,
	@iFk_ApprovedBy varchar(20) = null,
	@Flag varchar(1) = '1'
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF(@Flag = '1')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO MSTVEHDCMNT 
		(
			iFk_DcmntId ,
			IsExpired ,
			iNoOfDays ,
			dtCrtDate ,
			IsActive ,
			iFk_FinYear ,
			iFk_Createdby ,
			iFk_ApprovedBy 
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@iFk_DcmntId ,
			@IsExpired ,
			@iNoOfDays ,
			@dtCrtDate ,
			@IsActive ,
			@iFk_FinYear ,
			@iFk_Createdby ,
			@iFk_ApprovedBy 
		)
		SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Inserted' AS Message
	END
	IF(@Flag = '2')
	BEGIN
		UPDATE MSTVEHDCMNT SET iFk_DcmntId = @iFk_DcmntId ,
			IsExpired = @IsExpired ,
			iNoOfDays = @iNoOfDays
			 WHERE iPk_VehDcmntId = @iPk_VehDcmntId
			SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Updated' AS Message
	END
	IF(@Flag = '3')
	BEGIN
		SELECT * FROM MSTVEHDCMNT WHERE iPk_VehDcmntId = @iPk_VehDcmntId
	END
	IF(@Flag = '4')
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM MSTVEHDCMNT WHERE iPk_VehDcmntId = @iPk_VehDcmntId
		SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Deleted' AS Message
	END
	IF(@Flag = '5')
	BEGIN
		SELECT M.iPk_VehDcmntId,C.sName AS sDocumentName,M.IsExpired ,M.iNoOfDays FROM MSTVEHDCMNT M
		INNER JOIN CSTMENUM C ON C.iPK_CustEnum = M.iFk_DcmntId
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[DocRenewalAction]    Script Date: 21-04-2023 02:49:31 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DocRenewalAction]
(
	@iPk_DcmntRnwlId int  = 0,
	@iFk_DocumentType int =0,
	@iFk_VehicleId int = 0,
	@iFK_AgentId int = 0,
	@sDocNumber varchar(1500) = null,
	@dAmount decimal(18,2) = 0,
	@dtRenewalDate varchar(30) = null,
	@dtExpiryDate varchar(30) = null,
	@sAttchfile varchar(max) = null,
	@iFk_CreatedBy varchar(20) = null,
	@iFk_CheckedBy varchar(20) = null,
	@iFk_ApprovedBy varchar(20) = null,
	@iFk_YearId int = 0,
	@iFk_BranchId int = 0,
	@sIpAddress varchar(500) = null,
	@sLongitude varchar(500) = null,
	@sLatitude varchar(500) = null,
	@sBrowser varchar(500) = null,
	@sDevice varchar(500) = null,
	@iIsDeleted int = 0,
	@Flag varchar(1) = '1'
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF(@Flag = '1')
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO DCMNTRNWL
		(
			iFk_DocumentType,
			iFk_VehicleId ,
			iFK_AgentId ,
			sDocNumber,
			dAmount ,
			dtRenewalDate ,
			dtExpiryDate ,
			sAttchfile ,
			iFk_CreatedBy ,
			iFk_CheckedBy,
			iFk_ApprovedBy,
			iFk_YearId,
			iFk_BranchId ,
			sIpAddress,
			sLongitude ,
			sLatitude,
			sBrowser,
			sDevice,
			iIsDeleted
		)
		VALUES
		(
			@iFk_DocumentType,
			@iFk_VehicleId ,
			@iFK_AgentId ,
			@sDocNumber,
			@dAmount ,
			@dtRenewalDate ,
			@dtExpiryDate ,
			@sAttchfile ,
			@iFk_CreatedBy ,
			@iFk_CheckedBy,
			@iFk_ApprovedBy,
			@iFk_YearId,
			@iFk_BranchId ,
			@sIpAddress,
			@sLongitude ,
			@sLatitude,
			@sBrowser,
			@sDevice,
			@iIsDeleted
		)
		SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Inserted' AS Message
	END
	IF(@Flag = '2')
	BEGIN
		SELECT C.iPk_DcmntRnwlId,E.sName AS sDocName,V.sUnqIdNo AS sVehicleName,sDocNumber,dtRenewalDate,dtExpiryDate,
		C.dAmount,sAttchfile  From DCMNTRNWL C
		INNER JOIN CSTMENUM E ON C.iFk_DocumentType = E.iPK_CustEnum
		INNER JOIN MST_Veh V ON V.iPK_ID = C.iFk_VehicleId 
	END
	IF(@Flag = '3')
	BEGIN
		DELETE FROM DCMNTRNWL WHERE iPk_DcmntRnwlId  = @iPk_DcmntRnwlId
		SELECT 200 AS StatusCode,'SuccessFully Deleted' AS Message
	END
END
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[GetddlforCardRC]    Script Date: 21-04-2023 02:49:31 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO
alter PROCEDURE [dbo].[GetddlforCardRC]
(
	@type varchar(20) = null,
	@Flag varchar(1) = '1'
)
AS
BEGIN
	IF(@Flag = '1')
	BEGIN
		IF(@type = 'CardName')
		BEGIN
			SELECT C.iPK_CustEnum AS DDLValue,C.sName AS DDLText from CSTMENUM C 
			INNER JOIN MSTVEHCRD M ON M.sCardName = C.sName WHERE C.iFK_EnumNo = 13
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT iPK_ID AS DDLValue,sUnqIdNo AS DDLText FROM MST_Veh 
		END
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF(@type = 'DocName')
		BEGIN
			SELECT C.iPK_CustEnum AS DDLValue,C.sName AS DDLText from CSTMENUM C 
			INNER JOIN MSTVEHDCMNT M ON M.iFk_DcmntId = C.iPK_CustEnum 
		END
		ELSE IF(@type = 'AgentName')
		BEGIN
			SELECT iPK_ID AS DDLValue,sUnqIdNo AS DDLText FROM MST_Veh
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT iPK_ID AS DDLValue,sUnqIdNo AS DDLText FROM MST_Veh
		END
	END
	
END
GO
